reviews.title: Build quality is lacking
reviews.comment: It's a good looking case, but build quality is lacking. The panels are really flimsy, you can bend them if you're not careful. Don't put anything on top of the case, the top panel will bend with pressure. The HDD lights bleads into the power button. And finally, the opening for cables are way too big, if you're not good with cable management, you will definitely see them, even if you use a back-connect motherboard, some cable grommet would help. This would be a good case at $80, but for $140, its disappointing. EDIT: Back-connect motherboard does not work with this case. There's not enough room in the back. The USB header cable stick out way too much, you can not close the back panel.
